title: CONNECT-UDP Forwarding Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for RFC 9298 forwarding, congestion, QUIC DATAGRAM, and ECN policy.
scope: This verification covers burstiness and batching guidance, congestion-control disablement preconditions, ECN signaling and Not-ECT policy, HTTP/3 preference, QUIC DATAGRAM frame use and payload limits, oversized target payload drop and ICMP Packet Too Big recommendation, inner IP header prohibition, and UDP proxy ECN ownership.
preconditions: RFC 9298 datagram Context ID codec and target filtering slices are trace-owned.
expected_result: The focused forwarding-policy tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9298 forwarding-policy artifacts, generated triage reflects the slice as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9298 forwarding/congestion/ECN policy surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates. Live UDP forwarding and PMTU/ICMP adapter integration remain future work.
